reason: The inherited WP-03 future target is definitionally a complete 30-minute construct: it requires future5, future15, future30, final_close at index 29 and last10 bars. It cannot produce a causal event-level first-hit minute from partial future windows.
interpretation: This preserves the exact preregistered target and refuses to fabricate sub-window timing. A later dedicated event-time target is required for event-level lead-time science.
